title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: “RJ, what kind of example are you setting for the rest of Tigers scouts?”
“Are you ready to become a leader?”
My wife says I need to send you a hand written thank you note since you’ve basically publicly petitioned for me to get a raise 😂 It means a lot that you’ve done this for me...twice. Thank you.
